task: Trip readiness review for Thailand. Write a pre-departure checklist from the supplied records only: the entry requirement and documents to prepare, what to pack for each recorded season, and how to get around with each recorded transit option. One item per record. Where a record is missing or a rule must be confirmed, say to check Smartraveller or the official source.

evidence.title: Thailand — entry requirement
evidence.text: Records supplied: 1 of 1 weather notes, 1 of 1 transit options. Visa requirement on record: visa-free. Entry notes: Short-stay tourist entry. Proof of onward travel and accommodation is sometimes checked at immigration.

evidence.title: Thailand — weather: Hot (Mar-May)
evidence.text: Season: Hot (Mar-May). Extreme heat and seasonal haze inland. Schedule sightseeing for early morning or late afternoon.

evidence.title: Thailand — transit: ferry
evidence.text: Transit type: ferry. Chao Phraya express boats are the fastest way to reach riverside temples in Bangkok during traffic peaks.

plan.objective: Create a pre-departure checklist for Thailand based on the provided evidence.

steps.description: Gather required documents, including proof of onward travel and accommodation.
Check the official government website for the most up-to-date information on entry requirements and visa requirements.
Pack accordingly for each season: hot (Mar-May), with consideration for extreme heat and seasonal haze inland.
Research and book transportation options, including ferry services, to ensure smooth travel.
Verify the most efficient way to reach riverside temples in Bangkok during traffic peaks.

success_criteria: The checklist includes a clear section for gathering required documents.
The checklist provides guidance on packing for each season.
The checklist includes a transportation section with recommended options.
The checklist includes information on reaching riverside temples in Bangkok during traffic peaks.
